## Modules

- [AnovaVisualizer](https://anova-visualizer.hexdocs.pm/AnovaVisualizer.md): Generates interactive VegaLite visualizations for ANOVA and Tukey's HSD analysis results
using Kino.VegaLite for Livebook integration.
